caption: 400 fresh test theorems, two paths per theorem, three fixed training seeds per arm. Large dots show three-seed means; faint dots show individual fixed training seeds. Bars are paired 95% family-stratified theorem-bootstrap intervals, conditional on the trained models. Model input tokens are expected charged policy work, not forced-eight-path measurement expense. Cost-aware training reward is selected correctness minus 0.03 per additional attempt; correctness-only reward omits that penalty. Native readout integrates learned categorical stopping and index probabilities. No new statistics or fits.
